# brig secret list

Show which providers' secrets are stored, never their values

## Synopsis

```text
brig secret list [VM]
```

## Description

Show, for each credential of each provider that the VM's config directories
define in a workspace, where its secret comes from and whether it is stored.
brig looks each one up, as [`brig sync`](brig-sync.md) does, but never shows a value. A keyring
that is locked may ask you to unlock it.

## Examples

```sh
brig secret list dev
brig secret list dev -o json
```

## Options

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `-o, --output format` | output format: table or json (default `table`) |
| `--secret-tool string` | program to look secrets up with (default: openshell.secret\_tool from config.yaml) |
| `-w, --workspace string` | the workspace of the gateway to work in (default: $BRIG\_WORKSPACE, else default) |

The [global options](brig.md#options) of brig apply too.
